$comment: Brand content for the catalog: what Fourthwall doesn't hold (ID, release, position, category, Scripture, copy). When a product's slug (or fourthwallSlug) matches a Fourthwall product, Fourthwall supplies its variants, prices, stock and photos. Until then the product shows as a preview: the price, sizes and images here (apps/web/public/products), with checkout opening soon. `colors` maps garment color names to brand swatch tokens. `images` are listed in display order: listing image, hover image, then the rest.

collections.name: Behold
collections.tagline: A call to see Christ’s power, holiness, sacrifice, and resurrection.
collections.story: Six pieces, one call: look and see who he is. The holy one, the Lord of the storm, the Lamb of God, the risen King.
